spec.hypothesis: The monthly low-volatility composite (calmer stocks beat sector- and beta-matched peers) continues forward.
spec.rationale: Historical test on 2018-2026 was close but failed (Sharpe 0.21 vs 0.25; effect beyond beta not significant). Its features are closed for historical testing, so the only honest remaining test is forward, as an exploratory strategy that can never be promoted.
spec.decision_rule: Exploratory only: watch for 24 monthly rebalances. If forward results clearly beat the historical ones, write a NEW pre-registered hypothesis to test on later data; never promote this one directly.
